mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_outbox_events (id, tenant_id, aggregate_id, topic, tag, payload, attempt_count, last_error, published_at, next_attempt_at, claimed_until, claim_token, dead_lettered_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{aggregateId}, #{topic}, #{tag}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{attemptCount}, #{lastError}, #{publishedAt}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{claimedUntil}, #{claimToken}, #{deadLetteredAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM workflow_outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now}) AND (claimed_until IS NULL OR claimed_until < #{now}) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE workflow_outbox_events event SET claim_token = #{claimToken}, claimed_until = #{claimedUntil} FROM candidates WHERE event.id = candidates.id RETURNING event.*
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_outbox_events SET published_at = #{publishedAt}, last_error = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND published_at IS NULL
